items.title: Instant database branches for testing
items.oneliner: CLI creates MySQL and Postgres branches in seconds with ZFS snapshots for CI, migrations, and agent sandboxes.

items.title: Practical guide to positional embeddings
items.oneliner: Hands-on PyTorch walkthrough explains RoPE and relative embeddings with code you can adapt for modern LLM implementations.

items.title: FreeBSD bhyve live migration RFC
items.oneliner: Working code shows pre-copy VM migration over TCP for bhyve, useful for host maintenance and clustered virtualization experiments.

items.title: Visualizing conversation states in Qwen
items.oneliner: Deep dive maps 900 Qwen3 conversations to reveal topic clustering and residual-stream dynamics inside a small language model.

items.title: Survey of C memory management
items.oneliner: Benchmark-style survey compares allocators, leak handling, and documentation patterns across 40 major C codebases.

items.title: Reverse engineering a Jeep ECU
items.oneliner: Video walkthrough shows an Arduino-based ECU reverse engineering workflow that automotive hackers can replicate with cheap hardware.

items.title: Minimal IR remote decoding guide
items.oneliner: Practical tutorial shows how to read many IR remote protocols with minimal code and inexpensive Vishay receivers.

items.title: Using Emacs as a browser
items.oneliner: Configuration guide turns EWW into a usable daily browser with keybindings, media helpers, and distraction-free workflows.

items.title: NetBSD disk encryption playbook
items.oneliner: Detailed guide explains threat models, boot tradeoffs, and directory-level secrecy for deploying practical disk encryption on NetBSD.

items.title: Simpler architecture for FRC robots
items.oneliner: This robotics tutorial replaces overengineered command stacks with a single periodic loop that students can understand and debug.
